visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a green beanie, a beige hoodie, and white undershirt stands behind a stainless steel counter. He pours a dark brown liquid from a measuring pitcher into a clear plastic cup. The background is a white wall with a large black 'WTF TEA EXPRESS' logo. The lighting is bright and even studio lighting. (2) The man holds up a small glass jar labeled 'SALSA TARTUFATA' towards the camera, smiling. Yellow variety text appears near the jar. He is shown in a medium close-up, highlighting his facial expression and the object details. (3) The man uses a long metal bar spoon to stir the dark liquid in the plastic cup. The camera angle is slightly lowered to focus on the mixing action. He then pours a thick, creamy white foam layer from a green-lidded pitcher onto the drink. (4) He holds up a single, whole black truffle between his thumb and forefinger, bringing it close to the lens for a close-up. He then uses a wooden truffle shaver to slice thin pieces of the truffle directly onto the foam of the drink. (5) The man presents the completed beverage to the camera, gesturing with his open palms and smiling proudly. The drink is topped with numerous shaved truffle slices and a dusting of powder. Captions appear at the bottom of the frame.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator performing the drink preparation.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male chef wearing a green 'LA' beanie, a beige hoodie over a white long-sleeved shirt, and a wristwatch.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean white studio wall featuring a large, stylized 3D black logo that reads 'WTF' over 'TEA EXPRESS'. A stainless steel kitchen prep table is in the foreground.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A lively, high-tempo orchestral track featuring staccato strings and bright brass commences. The music has a playful, slightly comedic but high-class 'grand' feeling. There is no human speech. (2) A subtle liquid splash sound occurs as the dark chocolate mixture is poured, but it is heavily masked by the dominant BGM. (3) A distinct metallic click or rhythmic scraping sound is audible as the truffle shaver is used, synced with the musical rhythm. (4) Orchestral hits or cymbal crashes emphasize the visual transitions between the prep and the final presentation of the drink. The music remains the sole structural audio layer until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Detail -> Close-up Reveal -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase and promote a limited-time, high-end collaborative beverage (Truffle Hazelnut Chocolate) for Valentine's Day at WTF Tea Express, featuring the personality of Chef Fred.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a well-known chef (Fred) creating a specific branded drink in a shop with visible logos and call-to-action text for a specific sale date.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses the contrast between fast-paced classical music and high-end ingredients to create a 'luxurious but fun' vibe typical of social media food influencers.
